title: Model declaration does not complete release setup
when: A governed project approaches its first release
need: Each model also needs migration_fleet: named databases with project boot/verification commands, engine tenants only for that topology, or none with a reason. Project-admin declares it; release uses target-specific coverage. Item rehearsal and fleet receipts prove different things.
surface: Fleet reference lines 14–56 and 133–154; release refusal names declaration recipe.
gap: Verified gap: onboard declares migration_model but never migration_fleet; later release refuses missing fleet. Proposed release-readiness lesson must collect the real fleet/boot facts or explicit none before dispatch.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type migration_fleet --json
